question: How does MCL treat a special (ad-hoc) inspection differently from a routine (recurring) inspection, in scheduling and in reports?
title: Special vs. routine inspections: what MCL actually distinguishes, in scheduling and in reports
summary_for_reviewer: MCL has two unrelated mechanisms that map onto the question. (a) A per-run Reason label (Routine/Special) chosen on the mobile start screen, stored on the run header, normalized server-side to canonical German values on finish, and surfaced in the report header ('Format'), in mobile history/report detail, and as a mandatory single-select filter in the dashboard's Data Analysis charts. (b) A per-checklist Periodicity (N/A, Daily…Yearly) set in the dashboard wizard, which is what actually drives due windows, the mobile deadline marker, and planned-vs-executed / not-completed tracking — checklists with periodicity NONE are explicitly excluded from all of that. I verified that no scheduling, completion or compliance query filters on the run type: crh_type appears in the dashboard's statistics layer only once, as a passthrough projection, and all type filtering is confined to the indicators/chart queries. Confidence is high on every claim below; each is a direct read of this commit.

evidence_files.why: The Reason label and its two option strings ('REASON:', 'Routine', 'Special'); confirms user-facing wording.
The start screen builds the Reason label plus a two-option segmented control; SelectOne defaults to 0 (Routine).
On Start checklist, SelectOne maps to checkListRun.Type = 'Routinekontrolle' | 'Sonderkontrolle'; nothing else in the run header depends on it.
iOS equivalent: iPad uses a UISegmentedControl (segment 0 preselected), iPhone uses two tappable images with type = true (Routine) as the default.
SetHeaderDefaultFormat normalizes de/es/en spellings of Routine/Special to the canonical German values.
Printed/exported report: Report_Format caption plus GetFormat(lang, crh_type) translating to Routinekontrolle/Rutina/Routine and Sonderkontrolle/Especial/Special.
On-screen report detail assigns crh_type to the Format label raw, without GetFormat translation.
Data Analysis 'Report type' combo with exactly two items, values Routinekontrolle / Sonderkontrolle.
GetChart1Ranking hard-filters crh.crh_type == TypeId; all Data Analysis charts are single-type.
Executed-checklist counting filters on company/date/market only, never on type.
The full periodicity option list offered in the UI: NONE (shown as 'N/A'), DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, QUARTERLY, BIANNUAL, YEARLY.

uncertainties: Whether the Reason can be changed after an inspection is finished.
Whether the mobile Reason control is ever hidden by company configuration.
Reason wording is localized per device/dashboard language and the API normalizes to canonical German values.
The dashboard has several report-viewing pages and several report-rendering generations; I verified the current one but did not audit older/unreferenced report pages.
How a given company actually uses the Routine/Special label operationally is policy, not code.
